title: I'm overwhelmed as a caregiver and need help from my family
intro: Caregiving can become overwhelming before families realize how much one person is carrying. We'll help you identify where support is needed and how to ask family members for specific help.
reassurance: The best caregivers ask for help — it's how they keep going.

roadmap.whatsHappeningNow: Caregiver stress is real and cumulative. Recognizing it is the first step toward a more sustainable path.
whatMayComeNext: Unaddressed burnout affects your health and your parent's care.
Sharing the load early prevents resentment and crisis.
Support and respite can restore your energy.
changesToWatchFor: Your own exhaustion, sleep, and mood
Tasks piling up faster than you can manage
howToPrepare: Make a specific list of tasks others could take on.
Call a family conversation to share responsibilities.
Look into respite care and caregiver support resources.
